name: Tevesh Szat
description: A draconic planeswalker and member of Urza's Nine Titans whose betrayal Urza predicted and used to engineer Phyrexia's demise.

description_citations.text: "Tevesh Szat". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: At the Summit of the Null Moon, Faralyn, Leshrac and Szat betray the others; Szat kills Chromium so they can escape to Shandalar.
timeline.quote: Szat killed Chromium, who was powerful enough to allow them to escape

citation.text: "Chromium Rhuell", section "Death". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ravidel lures six planeswalkers to Corondor with the Mox Beacon and forces them to battle in the Planeswalker War.
timeline.quote: The planeswalker Ravidel used an artifact known as the Mox Beacon to lure other planeswalkers to Corondor.

citation.text: "Corondor", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ravidel creates the Mox Beacon to lure Corondor's old enemies in the Planeswalker War.
timeline.quote: created the Mox Beacon to lure them to Corondor

citation.text: "Dominaria (plane)", section ""Modern times"". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Icatia, weakened by the Farrelite Cult, finally falls to orcs, goblins, thrulls and thallids aided by Tevesh Szat, and Vodalia is conquered by homarids.
timeline.quote: The last empire to fall was Icatia

citation.text: "Sarpadia", section "Fall of the Empires". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tev and Tymolin are caught up in the Brothers' War with disastrous results, leaving Tev guilt-ridden and exiled from society in Sarpadia.
timeline.quote: Tev was left guilt-ridden, and eventually the two returned to Sarpadia where Tev chose to exile himself from society.

citation.text: "Tevesh Szat", section "Youth". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tev refuses Tymolin's plea to intervene against the forces of chaos.
timeline.quote: Tev continued his lack of intrusion, refusing to either stop the orcs and goblins or help the dwarves.

citation.text: "Tevesh Szat", section "Sarpadia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Oliver Farrel and the Farrelites attack Tev and Tymolin; Tev disenchants Sianna's cloak and Tymolin is separated from him.
timeline.quote: Oliver Farrel and his Farrelites attacked Tev and Tymolin.

citation.text: "Tevesh Szat", section "Transformation to Tevesh Szat". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tev's planeswalker spark ignites and his appearance turns draconic as he declares himself the Doom of All Fools; he incinerates thallids attacking Loren.
timeline.quote: As his Planeswalker spark ignited, his grip on humanity began to slip

citation.text: "Tevesh Szat", section "Transformation to Tevesh Szat". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sensing his sister's death, Tev fully transforms into a serpentine dragon form and incinerates the Ebon Hand encampment, killing Sianna, Farrel and Vaylesh.
timeline.quote: Tev incinerated everyone present, including Sianna, Oliver Farrel, and Vaylesh.

citation.text: "Tevesh Szat", section "Transformation to Tevesh Szat". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tev renames himself Tevesh Szat and summons the orc-goblin army onto Montford with a Planar Gate, then begins destroying the empires of Sarpadia.
timeline.quote: His first action was to use a Planar Gate to summon the orc–goblin army onto Montford .

citation.text: "Tevesh Szat", section "Fall of Sarpadia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Order orders Sahr's execution over his derelor; Vaylesh's derelor is struck down by Tevesh Szat's Fireball.
timeline.quote: This eventually led to an order for Sahr's execution.

citation.text: "Thrull", section "Sarpadian Thrulls". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Betrayers escape the Shard after Chromium and Ravidel die at the Summit of the Null Moon.
timeline.quote: No planeswalker died, but the deaths of Chromium Rhuell and Ravidel proved enough to let the betrayers escape.

citation.text: "Dominaria (plane)", section "Ice Age". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tevesh Szat plans to leave Dominaria in eternal slumber under ice.
timeline.quote: wanted to give Dominaria a goodbye present: eternal slumber under a thick layer of ice.

citation.text: "Dominaria (plane)", section "Ice Age". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jason's green magic deals Freyalise a fatal blow in a duel ordered by Miko; she converts to green and becomes a planeswalker.
timeline.quote: she chose to spurn red and convert to green herself.

citation.text: "Freyalise", section "Ascension". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Freyalise fights Szat on Azoria, destroys the islands of the plane, and is blinded by Szat.
timeline.quote: She fought Szat on Azoria and was left for dead after destroying all the islands of the plane.

citation.text: "Freyalise", section "Ice Age". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Freyalise arms and instructs Jaeuhl Carthalion to expel Szat.
timeline.quote: She also armed and instructed Jaeuhl Carthalion on his quest to expel Szat from Dominaria

citation.text: "Freyalise", section "Ice Age". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tevesh Szat warns Miko that Clan Emerald plots against him.
timeline.quote: Szat warns Miko that Clan Emerald plots against him

citation.work: Ice Age on the World of Magic: The Gathering
citation.text: "Ice Age on the World of Magic: The Gathering", section "The Twilight Kingdom". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jason and Freyalise duel; Szat's wind drops them on the Bridge of Hielos and the glacier crashes down on Storgard.
timeline.quote: Neither mage pauses to notice that the folly of their conflict has forced the glacier to come crashing down on the castle.

citation.work: Ice Age on the World of Magic: The Gathering
citation.text: "Ice Age on the World of Magic: The Gathering", section "The Twilight Kingdom". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jason, influenced by Szat, uses black mana and mortally wounds Freyalise, then rejects the demon's temptation.
timeline.quote: Jason shoots the Fyndhorn Bow and wounds her mortally.

citation.work: Ice Age on the World of Magic: The Gathering
citation.text: "Ice Age on the World of Magic: The Gathering", section "The Twilight Kingdom". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Faralyn hosts the Summit of the Null Moon with the planeswalkers trapped in the Shard.
timeline.quote: For ten centuries, they have been trapped within a tiny formation of twelve worlds

citation.work: Ice Age on the World of Magic: The Gathering
citation.text: "Ice Age on the World of Magic: The Gathering", section "The Shard". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Szat kills Chromium Rhuell with Dark Banishing and combat breaks out.
timeline.quote: Szat follows through with Dark Banishing , killing the mighty dragon.

citation.work: Ice Age on the World of Magic: The Gathering
citation.text: "Ice Age on the World of Magic: The Gathering", section "The Shard". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Szat reveals he is in league with Faralyn and Leshrac and plans to silence Dominaria.
timeline.quote: He reveals that he was in league with Faralyn and Leshrac all along

citation.work: Ice Age on the World of Magic: The Gathering
citation.text: "Ice Age on the World of Magic: The Gathering", section "The Shard". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Szat's Soul Burn gravely injures Freyalise before he flees.
timeline.quote: injuring Freyalise horribly before he flees from the duel

citation.work: Ice Age on the World of Magic: The Gathering
citation.text: "Ice Age on the World of Magic: The Gathering", section "The Shard". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Szat's Priest of Yawgmoth plots to unleash a killing cold on Dominaria from the ruins of Storgard.
timeline.quote: he wants to unleash a coldness with blue mana that will kill all living things on Dominaria

citation.work: Ice Age on the World of Magic: The Gathering
citation.text: "Ice Age on the World of Magic: The Gathering", section "Forever Silent the World". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Szat attacks Jaeuhl in the ruins of Soldev and an Icequake begins.
timeline.quote: an Icequake starts, and to Szat's glee, the temperature begins to drop significantly

citation.work: Ice Age on the World of Magic: The Gathering
citation.text: "Ice Age on the World of Magic: The Gathering", section "Forever Silent the World". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jaeuhl tosses the Amulet of Quoz and defeats Szat.
timeline.quote: the Amulet falls head's up and grants Jaeuhl victory. Szat is defeated.

citation.work: Ice Age on the World of Magic: The Gathering
citation.text: "Ice Age on the World of Magic: The Gathering", section "Forever Silent the World". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Szat and Lim-Dul escape through a portal to Shandalar.
timeline.quote: a portal opens up to transport Szat and Lim-Dûl to Shandalar

citation.work: Ice Age on the World of Magic: The Gathering
citation.text: "Ice Age on the World of Magic: The Gathering", section "Forever Silent the World". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Trapped in the Shard during the Ice Age, Leshrac summons an elder dragon against Kristina of the Woods and plans to conquer Shandalar with Tevesh Szat.
timeline.quote: He wanted to conquer that mana -rich plane , and allied with Tevesh Szat to achieve this.

citation.text: "Leshrac", section "The Ice Age". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Leshrac escapes to Shandalar and starts the War for Shandalar, but without his undead host he is defeated by Kenan Sahrmal.
timeline.quote: he was defeated by Kenan Sahrmal

citation.text: "Leshrac", section "The Ice Age". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At the Summit of the Null Moon battle erupts among the planeswalkers; Ravidel and Rhuell die and Taysir and Kristina revive Ravidel.
timeline.quote: Taysir and his lover combined their magic to bring Ravidel back to life

citation.text: "Taysir of Rabiah", section "Ice Age". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Szat manipulates the battle between Freyalise and Jason Carthalion so that Storgard is damaged, and patronizes Lim-Dul with Leshrac.
timeline.quote: Szat and another evil planeswalker, Leshrac , acted as patrons to the necromancer Lim-Dûl during his war against Kjeldor .

citation.text: "Tevesh Szat", section "Ice Age". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Szat fights Freyalise at the Summit of the Null Moon, tries to intensify the Ice Age, and is defeated by Jaeuhl Carthalion and later by Kenan Sahrmal on Shandalar.
timeline.quote: where he was defeated again, this time by Kenan Sahrmal .

citation.text: "Tevesh Szat", section "Ice Age". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza recruits Szat for the Nine Titans, but Szat betrays them, frees the Primeval Dragons through Darigaaz and kills Daria and Kristina.
timeline.quote: However, Szat betrayed the Titans, convinced Darigaaz to free the Primeval Dragons , and killed Daria and Kristina of the Woods .

citation.text: "Tevesh Szat", section "Nine Titans". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza reveals he foresaw the betrayal and uses Szat's life energy to fuel the soul bombs that devastate Phyrexia, killing him.
timeline.quote: Fueling the bombs was the end of Szat.

citation.text: "Tevesh Szat", section "Nine Titans". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kristina turns Taysir away and he turns to vengeance against Leshrac and Tevesh Szat.
timeline.quote: she has no choice but to turn him away

citation.text: "Alliances (comic)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tevesh Szat and Leshrac arrive on the Null Moon and Leshrac convinces Szat to imprison Daria in an Amber Prison rather than kill her.
timeline.quote: proposing that she instead be imprisoned within an Amber Prison .

citation.text: "Planeswalker War", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Szat attacks Grenfell Mor to learn the secret of the Grey Chime and leaves Telemar to find its fragments.
timeline.quote: Szat abandoned Telemar to pursue the chime’s fragments.

citation.text: "Planeswalker War", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Szat gathers the fragments of the Grey Chime; Kristina, Sandruu and Freyalise assault Telemar.
timeline.quote: Kristina, Sandruu, and Freyalise launched their assault on Telemar.

citation.text: "Planeswalker War", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Szat learns of the five houses' Grey Chime pieces and sets out to collect them.
timeline.quote: Szat heads away from Telemar to collect the five pieces of the chime.

citation.text: "Planeswalker War (comic)", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Szat defeats Jared and steals the Red Mana Battery.
timeline.quote: Jared is then assaulted by Tevesh Szat, who quickly defeats him and steals his Red Mana Battery

citation.text: "Planeswalker War (comic)", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Grenfell Mor, insane, hands Szat the final piece of the Chime.
timeline.quote: Grenfell Mor has gone completely insane at this point and presents Szat with the final part of the Chime.

citation.text: "Planeswalker War (comic)", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sandruu disintegrates Grenfell Mor; Freyalise separates Szat from the Chime and Leshrac decides to activate it.
timeline.quote: Grenfell nearly kills Kristina with a spell but is then disintegrated by Sandruu.

citation.text: "Planeswalker War (comic)", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Leshrac rings the Chime as Kristina yanks it away and Telemar goes up in a mushroom cloud.
timeline.quote: Leshrac rings the chime just as Kristina yanks it from his hands, and Telemar goes up in a mushroom cloud.

citation.text: "Planeswalker War (comic)", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Szat and Leshrac arrive on the Null Moon and put Daria in an Amber Prison instead of killing her.
timeline.quote: So instead he puts the girl in an Amber Prison .

citation.text: "Prelude to War", section "Planeswalker in Amber , by Jeff Grubb and Rags Morales". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At the Summit of the Null Moon, Faralyn, Szat and Leshrac manipulate the planeswalkers into fighting; Rhuell and Ravidel are killed.
timeline.quote: and so was Ravidel

citation.text: "Ravidel", section "Death and resurrection". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ravidel and Taysir trap Leshrac in Phyrexia, but Szat stays out of reach.
timeline.quote: They found Leshrac and trapped him in Phyrexia

citation.text: "Ravidel", section "Under the wings of Taysir". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ravidel plans to activate a Mox Beacon to draw his enemies to Dominaria, and succeeds in drawing Szat to Corondor, starting the Planeswalker War.
timeline.quote: Ravidel was destined to succeed in drawing Szat to Corondor

citation.text: "Ravidel", section "The planeswalker war". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: During the time of the Shard of the Twelve Worlds, Faralyn, Tevesh Szat, Leshrac and Lim-Dûl invade Shandalar.
timeline.quote: They immediately began to wage war upon the plane, ready to claim it for their own.

citation.text: "Shandalar", section "Sahrmal". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kenan Sahrmal defends Shandalar, but Lim-Dûl is beheaded by Sahrmal's followers and survives by moving his soul to another body.
timeline.quote: Lim-Dûl had survived by transferring his soul into another body

citation.text: "Lim-Dûl", section "War for Shandalar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Faralyn arrives on Shandalar from the Shard, mocks Tevesh Szat, Leshrac and Lim-Dûl, and claims the plane for himself.
timeline.quote: He mocks them for trying to betray him and claims Shandalar for his own.

citation.text: "Shandalar (comic)", section "Volume 1: Exiles In The Promised Land". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tevesh Szat and Lim-Dûl arrive; Lim-Dûl is entombed in stone, and Leshrac burns him in a fire spell, causing Szat to flee.
timeline.quote: Leshrac conjures an immense fire spell and seemingly obliterates the necromancer.

citation.text: "Shandalar (comic)", section "Volume 1: Exiles In The Promised Land". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Szat reflects on Dominaria and his sister, blaming himself for Tymolin's death.
timeline.quote: all pleasure perished when he let Tymolin die

citation.text: "Shandalar (comic)", section "Volume 1: Exiles In The Promised Land". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Magus sends bats; Bani is crippled by fear and Lim-Dûl casts Mind Whip on Ravash, who falls to her death. Bani vows to kill Szat.
timeline.quote: Ravash slips on the edge of a precipice and falls to her death.

citation.text: "Shandalar (comic)", section "Volume 1: Exiles In The Promised Land". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Bani and her allies fight Tevesh Szat, now calling himself World-Ender, in the desert while Sahrmal watches in astral form.
timeline.quote: who now calls himself World-Ender

citation.text: "Shandalar (comic)", section "Volume 2: The Threshold". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Lim-Dûl plots to trick Sahrmal into attacking the planeswalkers, creates Manabarbs against Szat; Sahrmal joins with Fire Sprites, Szat devours Anthanor and casts Winter's Chill.
timeline.quote: The spell completely devours the soldier.

citation.text: "Shandalar (comic)", section "Volume 2: The Threshold". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sahrmal reveals his mortal form and protects Bani, but Szat stuns him with Infernal Darkness.
timeline.quote: This is the moment that Sahrmal unveils his mortal form.

citation.text: "Shandalar (comic)", section "Volume 2: The Threshold". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Leshrac returns and tells Szat that Lim-Dûl is sapping him with manabarbs; the bickering planeswalkers retreat as Sahrmal casts Whimsy.
timeline.quote: Disgusted and frustrated with Shandalar's bizarre mana, Szat and Leshrac make a hasty retreat.

citation.text: "Shandalar (comic)", section "Volume 2: The Threshold". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza drains Tevesh Szat to power the soul bombs and later destroys Taysir; the Titans mutiny.
timeline.quote: Urza used the same failsafe and destroyed Taysir.

citation.text: "Bo Levar", section "Nine Titans". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tevesh Szat tells Darigaaz the legend of the Primeval Dragons and shows him the destroyed red Primeval's corpse in Shiv, saying the others can be awakened to aid the war.
timeline.quote: He showed Darigaaz the corpse of the red Primeval in Shiv

citation.text: "Darigaaz", section "Original Incarnation". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: During the Phyrexian Invasion, Tevesh Szat reveals the Primevals to Rhammidarigaaz.
timeline.quote: Tevesh Szat revealed the existence of the Primevals to Rhammidarigaaz

citation.text: "Dragon", section "Primeval Dragons". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza assembles planeswalkers with his Titan Engines but the gathering draws Phyrexians to Tolaria, so they go to Koilos.
timeline.quote: the gathering of ‘walkers draws the Phyrexians to the island, so they abandon it, traveling to Koilos to plan for the great battle.

citation.text: "Invasion (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza leads the Nine Titans in a counter-attack on Phyrexia; Tevesh Szat betrays and kills Daria, and Urza kills him, sealing him in a soul bomb.
timeline.quote: Urza activated the rubrik and killed Szat, sealing him in a Soul bomb

citation.text: "Phyrexia", section "Counter attack and betrayal". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Taysir is recruited among the Nine Titans for the attack on Phyrexia, with Daria taking Teferi's place and Urza insisting on Szat.
timeline.quote: Taysir was one of the Nine Titans recruited by Urza to participate in the attack on Phyrexia.

citation.text: "Taysir of Rabiah", section "Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Szat kills Kristina and later Daria during the assault.
timeline.quote: Szat killed Kristina by "accident" early in the assault, then hunted down and deliberately killed Daria later on.

citation.text: "Taysir of Rabiah", section "Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza states he counted on Szat's betrayal.
timeline.quote: Did I know Szat would betray us?

citation.text: Confound (Planeshift, 2001), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Tevesh Szat tells Darigaaz about the primevals; Darigaaz sets out to save the others.
timeline.quote: but Darigaaz sets out to save the others nonetheless.

citation.text: "Planeshift (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The nine planeswalkers attack Phyrexia with soul bombs; Tevesh Szat betrays them, killing Kristina and Daria, and Urza activates his kill rubric.
timeline.quote: Tevesh Szat betrays them, killing Kristina of the Woods and Daria .

citation.text: "Planeshift (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza predicts Tevesh Szat's betrayal and uses the planeswalker's life to engineer Phyrexia's demise.
timeline.quote: Urza predicted Tevesh Szat’s eventual betrayal, using the draconic Planeswalker’s life to engineer Phyrexia’s demise.

citation.text: "Tevesh Szat". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

relations.quote: When Urza drained Tevesh Szat to power the soul bombs

citation.text: "Bo Levar", section "Nine Titans". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.quote: Szat then told Darigaaz that the green Primeval was held in Yavimaya

citation.text: "Darigaaz", section "Freeing Rith". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.quote: Freyalise reminds Szat that he destroyed Storgard

relations.note: Rekindled an old ambition to conquer the world together.
relations.quote: Szat and Leshrac rekindled an old ambition — to conquer the world.

citation.text: Ice Age: card flavor text (Ice Age, 1995), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

citation.text: Planeshift: card flavor text (Planeshift, 2001), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.
